about: Mockup (October 2026, test build only): who belongs to each of the Raft's 54 organizations, one entry per membership with its source. from/to are titles in the villain's own steps (with a season for a whole show); raft_teams.json is built from these, plus Carl Creel's stages by hand (HYDRA in season 2, Talbot's bodyguard in season 3, HYDRA again in season 5).
